# Calcnate

> Calcnate (calcnate.com) is a free set of employment-money calculators and guides: end-of-service gratuity, final settlement, leave encashment, notice periods, probation and maternity pay for the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, India and the Philippines, plus redundancy, notice and holiday-pay tools for the UK, Canada, Australia and the US, and general money and time calculators. It is run by the Servia Group (servia.ae), a UAE company.

Each calculator page states the formula it uses and links to the law or government page it is based on. Calculations run in the visitor's browser; inputs are not sent to Calcnate. Results are estimates for guidance, not legal or financial advice. For how figures are sourced and checked, see the methodology page. Corrections: support@servia.ae or https://calcnate.com/contact/.

## Site information
- [About Calcnate](https://calcnate.com/about/): Calcnate builds free, source-cited end-of-service and gratuity calculators. Part of the Servia Group (servia.ae) — our editorial standards and who is behind it.
- [Calcnate Methodology](https://calcnate.com/methodology/): How Calcnate builds its calculators: every formula is sourced from official government labour laws and established law firms, and updated when the law changes.
- [Contact Calcnate](https://calcnate.com/contact/): Contact Calcnate, a Servia Group project. Email support@servia.ae for questions, corrections or feedback on our free labour-law calculators.
- [Privacy Policy](https://calcnate.com/privacy/): Calcnate privacy policy: calculators run in your browser, Google Analytics 4 measures visits, and contact-form messages are delivered through Google.
- [Terms of Use](https://calcnate.com/terms/): Terms for calcnate.com's free calculators: estimates for guidance only.
- [Use Calcnate in ChatGPT & Claude](https://calcnate.com/ai/): Add Calcnate's gratuity & end-of-service calculators to ChatGPT (Custom GPT Action) or Claude (MCP server). Free public API, OpenAPI schema included.
- [Calcnate Blog](https://calcnate.com/blog/): Comparisons, explainers and worked examples on gratuity, end-of-service benefits and final settlement across the UAE, GCC, India and the Philippines.
- [Global Calculators](https://calcnate.com/tools/): Free global calculators for money, pay and time: compound interest, loan EMI with amortisation, mortgage affordability, salary conversion, overtime.

## United Arab Emirates
- [United Arab Emirates hub](https://calcnate.com/uae/): All of Calcnate's UAE end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [UAE Final Settlement Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uae/final-settlement-calculator/): Combined UAE full & final settlement in one figure: end-of-service gratuity + unused leave encashment (at basic wage) + notice-period pay in lieu + pending salary, minus deductions, per Federal Decree-Law 33/2021.
- [Gratuity Calculator UAE](https://calcnate.com/uae/gratuity-calculator/): UAE: 21 days basic salary/year first 5 years, 30 days/year after, ÷30 daily, cap 2 years' wages, min 1 year, resignation no longer reduces it (Decree-Law 33/2021).
- [UAE Leave Encashment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uae/leave-encashment-calculator/): UAE leave encashment: 30 days/yr after 1yr (2 days/month for 6mo-1yr); encashed at BASIC salary ÷30 × unused days (Art.29 + Cabinet Resolution 1/2022 Art.19) -- different from in-service leave pay, which uses full wage.
- [UAE Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uae/maternity-leave-calculator/): UAE maternity (Art.30): 60 days total = 45 days full pay + 15 days half pay, no minimum service required, employer-paid.
- [UAE Notice Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uae/notice-period-calculator/): UAE notice: standard 30-90 days (contractual, Art.43) either party; probation (Art.44) employer-ends=14d, employee-resigns-to-UAE-employer=30d, employee-resigns-leaving=14d.
- [UAE Probation Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uae/probation-period-calculator/): UAE probation (Decree-Law 33/2021 Art.9): max 6 months, employer ends=14 days notice, employee resigns to new UAE employer=30 days, employee resigns to leave=14 days; no gratuity under 1yr service.
- [UAE Unemployment Insurance (ILOE) Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uae/unemployment-insurance-calculator/): UAE ILOE (unemployment insurance, Decree-Law 13/2022): 60% of avg basic salary (last 6mo), Category A (basic ≤16,000) capped AED 10,000/mo, Category B (basic >16,000) capped AED 20,000/mo, up to 3 months/claim, 12-month lifetime aggregate cap, needs 12 consecutive months' subscription, involuntary job loss only (not resignation/misconduct).
- [UAE Full & Final Settlement 2026: What You're Owed When You Leave](https://calcnate.com/uae/final-settlement-guide/): Everything in a UAE full & final settlement — gratuity, leave encashment, notice pay, pending salary and deductions — with a worked example.
- [UAE Gratuity Calculation 2026: The Complete Guide (with Examples)](https://calcnate.com/uae/gratuity-guide/): How UAE end-of-service gratuity works in 2026 — the 21/30-day rule, resignation vs termination, free zones, worked examples and when it must be paid.
- [UAE Leave Encashment 2026: Why It Is Paid on Basic Salary](https://calcnate.com/uae/leave-encashment-guide/): How UAE annual-leave encashment works in 2026 — the 30-day entitlement, why encashment uses basic salary while leave-in-service uses gross.
- [UAE Maternity Leave 2026: The 45+15 Day Rule Explained (Article 30)](https://calcnate.com/uae/maternity-leave-guide/): How UAE maternity leave works under Federal Decree-Law 33/2021 — the 60-day total, the 45 full-pay + 15 half-pay split, sick-newborn provisions.
- [UAE Notice Period 2026: The 30-90 Day Rule and Probation Explained](https://calcnate.com/uae/notice-period-guide/): How UAE notice periods work in 2026 under Federal Decree-Law 33/2021 — the standard 30-90 day rule, the probation sub-rules, and payment in lieu of notice.
- [UAE Probation Period Rules 2026: Notice Periods Explained (Article 9)](https://calcnate.com/uae/probation-period-guide/): How probation works in the UAE under Federal Decree-Law 33/2021 — the 6-month cap and the three different notice periods depending on why employment is ending.
- [UAE Unemployment Insurance (ILOE) 2026: How Much You Could Get Paid, Step by Step](https://calcnate.com/uae/unemployment-insurance-guide/): How the UAE's mandatory ILOE unemployment insurance scheme works in 2026 — eligibility, Category A vs B, the 60% payout formula, monthly caps.

## Saudi Arabia
- [Saudi Arabia hub](https://calcnate.com/saudi/): All of Calcnate's Saudi Arabia end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [Saudi End of Service Calculator](https://calcnate.com/saudi/end-of-service-calculator/): Saudi (ESB): ½ month/year first 5, 1 month/year after, on last wage incl. allowances; resignation reduced (0 under 2yr, ⅓ 2-5yr, ⅔ 5-10yr, full 10yr+).
- [Saudi Leave Encashment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/saudi/leave-encashment-calculator/): Saudi leave encashment: 21 days/yr (<5yr), 30 days/yr (5yr+); cannot be cashed out during employment (Art.109), mandatory at end of service (Art.111), on last wage (basic+regular allowances) ÷30.
- [Saudi Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/saudi/maternity-leave-calculator/): Saudi maternity (Art.151, amended RD M/44 eff.~Feb2025): 12 weeks (84 days) full pay, 6 weeks mandatory post-delivery, no minimum service (tenure tiers removed 2025).
- [Saudi Notice Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/saudi/notice-period-calculator/): Saudi notice (Art.75, amended eff. 18-Feb-2025): employee resigns=30d flat; employer ends=60d(monthly-paid)/30d(other).
- [Saudi Probation Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/saudi/probation-period-calculator/): Saudi probation (Art.53, amended RD M/44 eff.~Feb2025): max 180 days (contract-set), mutual termination rights, NO statutory notice period (contract governs), no gratuity owed.
- [Saudi Arabia End-of-Service Benefit 2026: How ESB Is Calculated](https://calcnate.com/saudi/end-of-service-guide/): How Saudi end-of-service (ESB) is calculated in 2026 — the ½ and 1-month bands, resignation reduction tiers, salary basis and worked examples.
- [Saudi Leave Encashment 2026: The 21/30-Day Rule and the End-of-Service-Only Rule](https://calcnate.com/saudi/leave-encashment-guide/): How Saudi annual-leave encashment works in 2026 — the 21 vs 30 day entitlement bands, why it can only be cashed out at end of service, and a worked example.
- [Saudi Maternity Leave 2026: The New 12-Week Full-Pay Rule (Article 151)](https://calcnate.com/saudi/maternity-leave-guide/): How Saudi maternity leave changed in 2025 — the move from 10 to 12 weeks, the removal of tenure-based pay tiers, mandatory post-delivery time.
- [Saudi Arabia Notice Period 2026: The New Employee-Employer Split](https://calcnate.com/saudi/notice-period-guide/): How Saudi notice periods work after the February 2025 Article 75 amendment: 30 days if you resign, 60 if the employer ends a monthly-paid contract.
- [Saudi Probation Period 2026](https://calcnate.com/saudi/probation-period-guide/): How probation works in Saudi Arabia after the 2025 Labor Law amendment (Article 53) — the 180-day cap, mutual termination rights.

## Qatar
- [Qatar hub](https://calcnate.com/qatar/): All of Calcnate's Qatar end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [Qatar Gratuity Calculator](https://calcnate.com/qatar/end-of-service-calculator/): Qatar: ≥21 days (3 weeks) basic wage per completed year, min 1 year, no resignation reduction.
- [Qatar Leave Encashment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/qatar/leave-encashment-calculator/): Qatar leave encashment: 21 days/yr (<5yr), 28 days/yr (5yr+) on basic wage (Art.79), ÷30 daily rate.
- [Qatar Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/qatar/maternity-leave-calculator/): Qatar maternity (Labour Law 14/2004 Art.96, private sector): 50 days full pay, requires 1+ year continuous service, min 35 days post-delivery.
- [Qatar Notice Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/qatar/notice-period-calculator/): Qatar notice (Art.49, monthly/annually-paid): <=5yr service=1 month, >5yr=2 months, either party.
- [Qatar End-of-Service Gratuity 2026: The 3-Week Rule Explained](https://calcnate.com/qatar/end-of-service-guide/): How Qatar gratuity is calculated in 2026 — the 21-day (3-week) minimum per year, basic-wage basis, one-year eligibility and a worked example.
- [Qatar Leave Encashment 2026: The 21 vs 28 Day Rule](https://calcnate.com/qatar/leave-encashment-guide/): How Qatar annual-leave encashment works in 2026 under Labour Law Article 79 — the 5-year entitlement jump, the basic-wage basis, and a worked example.
- [Qatar Maternity Leave 2026: The 50-Day Rule & the 1-Year Eligibility Test](https://calcnate.com/qatar/maternity-leave-guide/): How Qatar maternity leave works for private-sector employees under Labour Law 14/2004 — the 50-day full-pay entitlement.
- [Qatar Notice Period 2026: The 1-Month and 2-Month Rule](https://calcnate.com/qatar/notice-period-guide/): How Qatar notice periods work in 2026 under Labour Law Article 49 — the 5-year threshold, the 1 vs 2 month rule, and payment in lieu of notice.

## Kuwait
- [Kuwait hub](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/): All of Calcnate's Kuwait end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [Kuwait Indemnity Calculator](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/indemnity-calculator/): Kuwait indemnity: 15 days/year first 5, 1 month/year after, daily=monthly÷26, on full pay; cap 18 months; resignation reduced.
- [Kuwait Leave Encashment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/leave-encashment-calculator/): Kuwait leave encashment: 30 days/yr after 1yr; daily wage = monthly ÷26 (not 30), matching the indemnity divisor.
- [Kuwait Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/maternity-leave-calculator/): Kuwait maternity (Art.24): 70 days full pay, daily=monthly÷26, plus up to 4 months further unpaid childcare leave on request.
- [Kuwait Notice Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/notice-period-calculator/): Kuwait notice (indefinite contract): 3 months if monthly-paid, 1 month otherwise, either party, waivable via payment in lieu.
- [Kuwait Probation Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/probation-period-calculator/): Kuwait probation (Labour Law 6/2010 Art.32): max 100 working days, either party ends without notice or indemnity, only wages for days worked owed.
- [Kuwait End-of-Service Indemnity 2026: Rates, Resignation & the 18-Month Cap](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/indemnity-guide/): How Kuwait indemnity is calculated in 2026 — 15-day and 1-month bands, the ÷26 daily wage, resignation reductions and the 1.5-year cap, with an example.
- [Kuwait Leave Encashment 2026: Why the Divisor Is 26](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/leave-encashment-guide/): How Kuwait annual-leave encashment works in 2026 — the 30-day entitlement, the ÷26 daily-wage convention, and a worked example.
- [Kuwait Maternity Leave 2026: 70 Days Full Pay, Plus Unpaid Childcare Leave](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/maternity-leave-guide/): How Kuwait maternity leave works under Labour Law No. 6/2010 — 70 days full pay, the 4-month unpaid childcare extension, nursing breaks and a worked example.
- [Kuwait Notice Period 2026: 3 Months vs 1 Month Explained](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/notice-period-guide/): How Kuwait notice periods work in 2026 for indefinite contracts — the 3-month rule for monthly-paid workers, the 1-month rule for others, and payment in lieu.
- [Kuwait Probation Period 2026: 100 Days, No Notice Required (Article 32)](https://calcnate.com/kuwait/probation-period-guide/): How probation works in Kuwait under Labour Law No. 6/2010 — the 100-working-day cap, why no notice is legally required, and what you're actually owed.

## Bahrain
- [Bahrain hub](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/): All of Calcnate's Bahrain end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [Bahrain Leave Encashment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/leave-encashment-calculator/): Bahrain leave encashment: 30 days/yr (2.5/month) on GROSS salary (basic+fixed allowances) ÷30 (Art.58) -- different wage basis from Bahrain's notice pay-in-lieu.
- [Bahrain Leaving Indemnity Calculator](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/leaving-indemnity-calculator/): Bahrain: ½ month/year first 3 years, 1 month/year after, pro-rated from day one, on last wage.
- [Bahrain Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/maternity-leave-calculator/): Bahrain maternity (Art.32): 60 days full pay, +15 days optional unpaid, no cap on occurrences, employer-paid.
- [Bahrain Notice Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/notice-period-calculator/): Bahrain notice (Art.99(a)): flat 30 days either party, no sliding scale by service; pay-in-lieu on basic wage + social allowance (Art.47).
- [Bahrain Probation Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/probation-period-calculator/): Bahrain probation (Labour Law 36/2012 Art.21): max 3 months (6 by Ministerial decision), either party ends with 1 day notice, once per employer.
- [Bahrain Leave Encashment 2026: The 30-Day, Gross-Salary Rule](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/leave-encashment-guide/): How Bahrain annual-leave encashment works in 2026 under Labour Law Article 58 — the 30-day entitlement, why it uses gross salary, and a worked example.
- [Bahrain Leaving Indemnity 2026: How End-of-Service Is Calculated](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/leaving-indemnity-guide/): How Bahrain leaving indemnity works in 2026 — the ½ and 1-month bands, day-one accrual, who it covers and a worked example.
- [Bahrain Maternity Leave 2026: 60 Days Full Pay, Explained](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/maternity-leave-guide/): How Bahrain maternity leave works under Labour Law No. 36/2012 — 60 days full pay, the optional unpaid extension, the post-delivery work ban.
- [Bahrain Notice Period 2026: The Flat 30-Day Rule](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/notice-period-guide/): How Bahrain's notice period works in 2026 under Labour Law Article 99(a) — a flat 30 days for everyone.
- [Bahrain Probation Period Rules 2026: Length, Notice & What's Owed](https://calcnate.com/bahrain/probation-period-guide/): How probation works in Bahrain under Labour Law No. 36/2012 — the 3-month cap, the 1-day notice rule, the once-only limit, and what's owed if it ends early.

## Oman
- [Oman hub](https://calcnate.com/oman/): All of Calcnate's Oman end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [Oman Gratuity Calculator](https://calcnate.com/oman/gratuity-calculator/): Oman (RD 53/2023): 1 month basic/year for service from Aug 2023; earlier service 15 days/yr first 3 then 1 month/yr; min 1 year.
- [Oman Leave Encashment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/oman/leave-encashment-calculator/): Oman leave encashment: 30 days/yr; in-service cash-out is basic wage only (employer-optional, needs written consent); mandatory end-of-service encashment uses the comprehensive/gross wage.
- [Oman Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/oman/maternity-leave-calculator/): Oman maternity (RD 53/2023 Art.84): 98 days full pay (up from 50), no cap on occurrences, no minimum service (both removed by new law).
- [Oman Notice Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/oman/notice-period-calculator/): Oman notice (RD 53/2023 Art.38, unlimited contracts only): 30d monthly-paid / 15d other; pay-in-lieu on comprehensive/gross wage.
- [Oman Probation Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/oman/probation-period-calculator/): Oman probation (RD 53/2023 Art.37): max 3 months (monthly-paid) / 2 months (other), either party ends with 7 days notice, once per employer.
- [Oman End-of-Service Gratuity 2026: The New Law 53/2023 Explained](https://calcnate.com/oman/gratuity-guide/): How Oman gratuity is calculated in 2026 under Royal Decree 53/2023 — one month per year, the pre-August-2023 split, eligibility and a worked example.
- [Oman Leave Encashment 2026: Basic Wage In-Service, Gross Wage at End of Service](https://calcnate.com/oman/leave-encashment-guide/): How Oman annual-leave encashment works in 2026 under Royal Decree 53/2023 — the 30-day entitlement, the two different wage bases, and a worked example.
- [Oman Maternity Leave 2026: 98 Days Full Pay Under the New Law](https://calcnate.com/oman/maternity-leave-guide/): How Oman's new Labour Law (Royal Decree 53/2023) transformed maternity leave — 98 days full pay, no cap on occurrences, no minimum service.
- [Oman Notice Period 2026: The New Law 53/2023 Rule](https://calcnate.com/oman/notice-period-guide/): How Oman's notice period works in 2026 under Royal Decree 53/2023, Article 38 — 30 vs 15 days by pay frequency, why fixed-term contracts differ.
- [Oman Probation Period Rules 2026: The New Labour Law (RD 53/2023) Explained](https://calcnate.com/oman/probation-period-guide/): How probation works in Oman under the new Labour Law (Royal Decree 53/2023) — the 3-month/2-month cap, the 7-day notice rule.

## India
- [India hub](https://calcnate.com/india/): All of Calcnate's India end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [India Gratuity Calculator](https://calcnate.com/india/gratuity-calculator/): India (Payment of Gratuity Act): (last basic+DA × 15 × years) ÷ 26, after 5 years, >6 months rounds up, cap ₹20 lakh.
- [India Leave Encashment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/india/leave-encashment-calculator/): India leave encashment: (Basic+DA) ÷30 × unused earned-leave days (some employers use ÷26); tax-exempt up to ₹25 lakh lifetime for non-government employees (Sec.10(10AA)); annual entitlement RATE varies by state/sector so this tool encashes a user-supplied day balance rather than computing accrual.
- [India Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/india/maternity-leave-calculator/): India maternity (Maternity Benefit Act 1961 as amended 2017, Sec.5): 26 weeks (182 days) full pay for 1st/2nd child, 12 weeks (84 days) from 3rd; needs 80 days worked in prior 12mo; establishments with 10+ employees.
- [India Gratuity Calculation 2026: The 15/26 Formula, 5-Year Rule & ₹20 Lakh Cap](https://calcnate.com/india/gratuity-guide/): How Indian gratuity is calculated in 2026 under the Payment of Gratuity Act — the 15/26 formula, the 5-year eligibility, year rounding.
- [India Leave Encashment 2026: The Formula and the ₹25 Lakh Exemption](https://calcnate.com/india/leave-encashment-guide/): How Indian leave encashment is calculated in 2026 — the (Basic+DA)÷30 formula, why the annual entitlement rate varies by state.
- [India Maternity Leave 2026: The 26-Week Rule, Eligibility & the 3rd-Child Reduction](https://calcnate.com/india/maternity-leave-guide/): How Indian maternity leave works under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 (as amended 2017) — 26 vs 12 weeks, the 80-day eligibility test.

## Philippines
- [Philippines hub](https://calcnate.com/philippines/): All of Calcnate's Philippines end-of-service, gratuity and settlement calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [Philippines Leave Encashment Calculator (Service Incentive Leave)](https://calcnate.com/philippines/leave-encashment-calculator/): Philippines leave encashment: Service Incentive Leave (SIL), 5 days/yr after 1yr (Art.95), the only Labor Code leave type mandated commutable to cash; daily rate × unused SIL days.
- [Philippines Maternity Leave Calculator](https://calcnate.com/philippines/maternity-leave-calculator/): Philippines maternity (RA 11210): 105 days paid every pregnancy (no cap by child count), +15 days for solo parents (120 total), SSS-funded, needs 3 monthly SSS contributions in prior 12mo.
- [Philippines Notice Period Calculator](https://calcnate.com/philippines/notice-period-calculator/): Philippines notice: 3 regimes -- authorized-cause (redundancy/retrenchment/closure)=30d advance notice to employee+DOLE (Art.298, mandatory not payable-in-lieu); just-cause=no fixed notice, twin-notice due process instead (Art.297); resignation=30d, employer-waivable (Art.300). India notice period SKIPPED -- too fragmented across state Shops & Establishments Acts to state a single formula.
- [Philippines Probationary Employment Calculator](https://calcnate.com/philippines/probation-period-calculator/): Philippines probation (Labor Code Art.296): max 6 months; ends for just-cause or failure-to-meet-standards (no separation pay), or authorized-cause (separation pay owed, standard formula).
- [Philippines Separation Pay Calculator](https://calcnate.com/philippines/separation-pay-calculator/): Philippines: separation pay 1 month/year (redundancy) or ½ month/year (retrenchment/closure/disease), min 1 month; retirement 22.5 days/year (60-65, 5yr+); resignation none.
- [Philippines Leave Encashment 2026: Service Incentive Leave Explained](https://calcnate.com/philippines/leave-encashment-guide/): How Philippines Service Incentive Leave (SIL) encashment works in 2026 under Labor Code Article 95 — the 5-day minimum, who is exempt, and a worked example.
- [Philippines Maternity Leave 2026: 105 Days, Every Pregnancy — RA 11210 Explained](https://calcnate.com/philippines/maternity-leave-guide/): How Philippine maternity leave works under the Expanded Maternity Leave Law (RA 11210) — 105 days, the solo-parent bonus, SSS funding.
- [Philippines Notice Period 2026: Three Different Rules Explained](https://calcnate.com/philippines/notice-period-guide/): The Philippines has three distinct notice-period regimes depending on why employment ends — authorized cause, just cause, and resignation.
- [Philippines Probationary Employment 2026: The 6-Month Rule & When Pay Is Owed](https://calcnate.com/philippines/probation-period-guide/): How probationary employment works in the Philippines under Labor Code Article 296 — the 6-month cap, valid grounds to end it early.
- [Philippines Separation Pay 2026: How Much You're Owed by Cause](https://calcnate.com/philippines/separation-pay-guide/): How Philippine separation pay and retirement pay are calculated in 2026 — 1-month vs ½-month rules by cause, the 6-month rounding, retirement pay and examples.

## United Kingdom
- [United Kingdom hub](https://calcnate.com/uk/): All of Calcnate's UK redundancy, severance, notice, holiday and final-pay calculators and guides in one place — free, with sources cited.
- [UK Holiday Pay on Leaving Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uk/holiday-pay-calculator/): UK holiday pay on leaving (WTR 1998 reg 14): statutory 5.6 weeks (28 days for a 5-day week); accrued-untaken payout = entitlement × proportion of leave year worked − days taken, valued at a day's pay (normal remuneration).
- [UK Statutory Notice Pay Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uk/notice-pay-calculator/): UK statutory notice (ERA 1996 s.86): employer gives 1 week (1mo-2yr), then 1 week/complete year, cap 12 weeks; employee gives 1 week after 1 month. Notice pay = full weekly pay (not the redundancy cap).
- [UK Notice Period Calculator — Work Out Your Last Day](https://calcnate.com/uk/notice-period-calculator/): UK notice period end-date calculator: notice starts the day after it is given (ACAS); weeks end on the same weekday N weeks later; months end on the corresponding date (last day of month if none). Outputs last day of employment, calendar days, working days excl. England & Wales bank holidays 2025-2027.
- [UK Statutory Redundancy Pay Calculator](https://calcnate.com/uk/redundancy-pay-calculator/): UK statutory redundancy pay (ERA 1996): 1.5 wk/yr aged 41+, 1 wk/yr aged 22-40, 0.5 wk/yr under 22; cap 20 years; weekly-pay cap £751 (2026/27) / £719 (2025/26); max £22,530 / £21,570; needs 2 years' service. England, Wales, Scotland.
- [Leaving Holiday Pay: Questions Answered](https://calcnate.com/uk/holiday-pay-faq/): UK leaving-holiday questions answered — accrual, carry-over, bank holidays, and how holiday pay must reflect normal pay.
- [UK Holiday Pay When You Leave a Job 2026: How It's Calculated](https://calcnate.com/uk/holiday-pay-guide/): How accrued untaken holiday is paid out when you leave a UK job — the 5.6-week statutory minimum, the reg 14 (A×B)−C formula and a worked example.
- [How to Calculate Holiday Pay on Leaving](https://calcnate.com/uk/holiday-pay-how-to/): Step-by-step: work out accrued untaken holiday pay on leaving a UK job using the reg 14 (A×B)−C formula, with a worked example.
- [UK Notice Periods: Questions Answered](https://calcnate.com/uk/notice-pay-faq/): UK notice period questions answered — statutory vs contractual, gross misconduct, garden leave, PILON and pay during notice.
- [UK Statutory Notice Pay 2026: How Much Notice You're Owed](https://calcnate.com/uk/notice-pay-guide/): The UK statutory minimum notice period explained — 1 week per year up to 12 weeks, pay in lieu, resignation notice and worked examples.

## API and integrations
- API: https://api.calcnate.com/api/calc/gratuity?country=ae&basic=6000&years=7 (country codes: ae, sa, qa, kw, bh, om, in, ph; optional reason=term|resign)
- OpenAPI description: https://calcnate.com/openapi.yaml
- MCP manifest: https://calcnate.com/mcp.json
- Full calculator reference text: https://calcnate.com/llms-full.txt
